title: Geometry of Free Fermion Commutants
summary: Understanding the structure of operators that commute with $k$ identical replicas of unitary ensembles, also known as their $k$-commutants, is an important problem in quantum many-body physics with deep implications for the late-time behavior of physical quantities such as correlation functions and entanglement entropies under unitary evolution.
